buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support

AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Payment online through RTGS / internet banking also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name The Controller, CQA(AVA) Account No. 10372386858 IFSC Code SBIN0004675 Bank Name STATE BANK OF INDIA Branch address TANK FACTORY ROAD, HVF CAMPUS, PIN-600054 . Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The office of the bidder / service provider should be located within the TN state. The same will be verified during TE. Declaration to set up office on assigning of contract will not be accepted. 2. EPF, ESIC and Labour License, MSME registered within the state of consignee must be uploded by the bi dder. The same will be verified during Technical Evaluation. 3. EPF, ESIC payments should be made in the billing month (Must be submitted along with the monthly bill s) 4. If successful bidder failed to provide suitable manpower within 07 days of requirement, the bid/contract will be terminated unilaterally with or without intimation to service provider and with /without raising incid ent to GeM. Further to that any bid from the bidder will not be accepted in future for any kind. . 7. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 8.
